status: Published to main and verified in the production browser.
changes: Quartermaster direct and comparison purchases share safe bag delivery and validate level, class, gold and capacity before spending.
Comparison confirmation is one-shot; paid relic purchase retains the existing claim flow, with room checked for the replaced weapon. Reforging uses the same storage safety check.
Shop and comparison pages expose bag access and capacity.
Blocked ground loot uses the existing item comparison panel; collecting/selling the same item replaces the old outcome. Chest capacity warnings keep unopened contents hidden.
Pause button sits above the camera drag surface so clicks reach it.

evidence.logic: 22 transaction/pickup/chest cases and 6 presentation queue cases pass.
evidence.rarity: Existing chest-table suite passes 200,000 interval samples.

notYetVerified: Complete fresh-character campaign playthrough, fun/pacing and hardware performance
High-resolution visual-art acceptance (app captures were low resolution)
next: Continue the next authorized readiness work; retain the documented full-playthrough and Internet co-op limits.
